notes.title: Our demo is out!
notes.notes:
[p][b]🎒 The BARDA Demo is now live on Steam![/b][/p][p]It’s time to pack your bag and begin your adventure — our free demo is finally available!
In this first glimpse of [i]BARDA[/i], you’ll explore a few biomes, discover over a hundred unique items, and test your survival skills in runs lasting 1–2 hours.[/p][p]This demo is a faithful taste of the full game: charming visuals, tactical roguelike gameplay, and the thrill of building the perfect inventory.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback, so dive in, share your thoughts, and help us shape the journey ahead.[/p]

notes.title: First Playtest!
notes.notes:
[h1]The first playtest has begun![/h1]

Thank you all for following Barda! We have randomly picked 60 players to have an exclusive peek at a [b]very early build[/b] of the game: 0.2.1

It features the very basic fundations of the game: 
[list]
[*] Our 2D physics-based bag
[*] A first version of a randomly generated mountain to climb
[*] 75 items, alhtough many of them are still roughly drawn
[*] Exclusive preview of our new Volcano biome
[/list]

We're looking at any useful feedback or ideas you can give us, either here on Steam or over at our discord server: https://discord.gg/kAQXzQJMGm

If [b]you[/b] want to be part of Barda development, sign in for our future sessions!

Enjoy!
